cover.sub: 5 niche things that will make you
cover.title: dangerously ready for the si force

inner.title: what the force is
inner.body: a white house task force announced october 4, 2026, led by dni jay clayton. it has no published budget, mandate or legal powers yet.
inner.label: no powers yet

inner.title: the accord binds nobody
inner.body: the voluntary accord asks frontier model companies to run four layers of controls, with no penalties. its last paragraph says those steps may become laws.
inner.label: for now

inner.title: name an owner
inner.body: layer two is an internal team responsible for making sure the controls work and problems get fixed. if nobody on your team owns that, you already fail it.
inner.label: who, exactly

inner.title: get an outside check
inner.body: layer three is an independent auditor or evaluator checking whether your controls work as intended. grading your own homework does not count.
inner.label: not you

inner.title: selling to government
inner.body: nothing in the order applies to private companies, except anyone selling to government. their next renewal form and any new rfp will likely say si.
inner.label: read the rfp

closer.HEADLINE:
it's not law yet.
it's a preview.
closer.CTA: comment force and we'll reply with the full guide
